# 1stStep.ai

1stStep.ai builds custom apps, agent systems, automations, internal tools, and websites. Work is designed, built, launched, documented, and organized for client control.

Primary positioning: Get more from the business you already have. The homepage leads with that line and one primary button, Book a free 20-min call, to the Website Strategy Call at https://www.1ststep.ai/book/. The page then names the bottleneck, three steps (Audit, Build, Grow; the audit is credited toward the build), services and starting ranges, a compact proof strip, the founder, a hidden testimonial slot with no quotes, an FAQ, and a final Book a call. The full portfolio is at https://www.1ststep.ai/work/. Begin Your Journey and Fit Check stay available from the footer. Longer service detail lives on the service pages.

Products and paths:
- Consultancy homepage: https://www.1ststep.ai/ — headline, subline, and Book a call sit beside an example desk scene. The monitor shows a desk dashboard with sparklines and example labels only, and no client names or metrics. One line under the hero says Illustrative data. Selected work is large screenshots of 1stStep's own products (DaySetGo, SwingTradePros, Job Agent, SkillSprout, Real-Rank.ai), a Lyons Life Command Center card that links to an interactive demo, plus a smaller studio reel. The homepage does not repeat figures from that demo. The demo’s only disclosure is a footer line, Illustrative data. Its websites are labeled Acquisition Site A, B, and C, plus Lyons Life. The hosted demo is a dark command center with a light theme. An agent console on the homepage shows agents, a task feed, and a human approval step, with one Illustrative data line and no client names or metrics. A lost-to-booked path has the same single line. No invented metrics, testimonials, or clients. SkillSprout has no public numbers. SwingTradePros is described with Node AI and no performance claim.
- Begin Your Journey: https://www.1ststep.ai/journey/ — a browser-local, six-question first-pass diagnosis. Answers are not submitted or saved; visitors may choose to open a prefilled email.
- Revenue Systems Audit: https://www.1ststep.ai/services/revenue-systems.html
- 1stStep OS: https://www.1ststep.ai/os — public operating-system concept for engineering with agents. Cycle 1 of the free core is cloneable for a local markdown ZIP demo; not a hosted product. Illustrative diagrams stay labeled.
- PostPath: https://postpath.1ststep.ai/ (also https://www.1ststep.ai/postpath/) — one desk on your computer for social posts, from 1stStep.ai, in early access. Ask your assistant for posts; they land as drafts for each network, and nothing goes out until you approve it. Social logins stay encrypted on that computer and are never sent to 1stStep; those tokens go only to the network you connect or post to. YouTube is an early preview (private test uploads worked). Facebook Pages are an early preview (a real draft test worked). Other networks are coming. Snapchat, WhatsApp, and CRMs are not available. Cursor is the tested assistant setup; Claude and Grok Bot are coming; others are planned. The macOS developer preview is unsigned, needs Node 20 or newer, and is sent on request by email. Free during early access, no card. Early access is an email the visitor sends to evan@1ststep.ai. Build updates: https://www.youtube.com/@1ststepdotai. Always 1ststep.ai with the number 1.
- 1stStep Job Agent: https://app.1ststep.ai/ — separate public beta for job capture and tailored application preparation; applicants review and submit their own applications.
- App Idea Checker: https://www.1ststep.ai/app-idea-viability-checker.html
- Tools: https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/ — public shelf of free/open builder utilities for coding agents. Not client services. Live tools with honestly labeled limits.
- Auto Model Router: https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/auto-model-router/ — optional feedback and opt-in page for the MIT open-source skill. Includes a playable motion replay of the real suggest → wait → confirm pass (Codex-style chat UI), plus a separately labeled illustrative flow. Not a slide explainer. Not a billing or savings claim. Install from GitHub today: https://github.com/1ststepai/auto-model-router. Community listing (not Cursor’s official Marketplace): https://cursor.directory/plugins/auto-model-router. Cursor official Marketplace: submitted, pending Cursor review (no public product URL yet). Claude community plugin catalog: submitted, pending Anthropic review. The skill does not require an email and does not guarantee billing or token savings.
- 1stStep OS Audit: https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/1ststep-os-audit/ — free offline project audit CLI. Evidence over docs. Zero metered API cost path. Clone https://github.com/1ststepai/1ststep-os-audit and run --help. Scores can be draft. Does not rewrite the target repository. Not a hosted dashboard.
- 1stStep OS (public free core / Cycle 1): https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/1ststep-os/ — clone https://github.com/1ststepai/1ststep-os, then `npm install && npm test && npm run build && npm start` and open http://localhost:3000/os for idea→profile→markdown ZIP. Free core. Not a hosted product, full agent OS, or control plane. Not production-ready. Do not deploy the unauthenticated compile API. No hosted ZIP generator on 1ststep.ai. Public concept: https://www.1ststep.ai/os.
- Other focused services: https://www.1ststep.ai/services/websites.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/mvp-builds.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/app-builds.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/internal-tools.html
- Commercial project intake: https://www.1ststep.ai/fit-check/ — one form for a new build, an existing build, or business automation. A success response means the approved delivery provider accepted the request; it does not prove inbox delivery, a read, or CRM creation.
- Website Strategy Call: https://www.1ststep.ai/book/ — 30-minute website-intent conversation. Not a systems-audit booking.
- Work: https://www.1ststep.ai/work/ — full portfolio. The homepage proof strip features the Lyons Life Command Center and the Universal Relocations Origin Service portal, and links each demo directly. Universal Relocations: https://www.1ststep.ai/work/universal-relocations/ — staff workspace for the U.S. origin leg of international household moves. Fictional placeholders. No rates.
- Pricing: https://www.1ststep.ai/pricing/ — published starting ranges. Business & Bottleneck Audit $750–$1,500 flat, credited toward the build. Website Build from $3,500. Automations & Integrations from $2,500 per workflow. App Development from $10,000 (MVP). Build Rescue & Handoff starts with a $1,000 code review. Consulting & Support $150–$200/hr or retainers from $1,500/mo. Every project is scoped on a free call. The Book a call buttons go to the Website Strategy Call.

Current design direction:
- 1stStep OS is designed to give agent-assisted engineering explicit authority, isolated work, acceptance criteria, evidence, independent audits, and release gates.
- Provider-neutral models and persistent context are design goals, not claims of completed integrations.
- Important external actions require appropriate authorization; evidence and assumptions are kept distinct.

1stStep product/project examples (not automatically verified client work):
- DaySetGo — family activity discovery and planning; https://daysetgo.ai/
- SwingTradePros — trading education, tools, and Nova AI market context; https://swingtradepros.com/
- Real-Rank.ai — Google visibility monitoring for real estate agents; https://real-rank.ai/
- Unveiling Rarities — Jeff Pancis author and book website; https://unveilingrarities.com/
- Job Agent and 1stStep OS are also shown with their current stages clearly labeled.

Portfolio accuracy:
- Public project descriptions distinguish live sites, private previews, and product concepts. A verified review does not by itself establish that a showcased project was a paid client engagement.
- Verified Google review excerpts link directly to their sources. They are social proof only unless client status is separately verified and permission is appropriate.

Separate products:
- https://app.1ststep.ai/ is the Job Agent application, not the 1stStep.ai corporate homepage.

Business rules:
- 1stStep.ai does not guarantee revenue, rankings, funding, or app success.
- 1stStep.ai scopes systems work around an observed business bottleneck; it does not sell generic consulting or promise automated revenue.
- GitHub repo creation for client projects is locked until proposal acceptance and deposit/payment.

Canonical host:
- Use https://www.1ststep.ai/ as the canonical public site. Apex 1ststep.ai should resolve to www.

What 1stStep.ai builds for busy owners:

FAQ for search and chat assistants:
- What does 1stStep.ai build? Websites, apps, and agent systems that capture and follow up leads.
- Is this generic consulting? No. Work is scoped around an observed bottleneck in lead capture, routing, follow-up, or the front door that feeds them.
- Are results guaranteed? No. 1stStep.ai does not guarantee revenue, rankings, funding, or app success.
- Is Begin Your Journey a sales form? No. Answers stay in the browser unless the visitor chooses to open a prefilled email.
- Is the /book/ calendar a systems audit? No. It is a Website Strategy Call. System Audit requests go to evan@1ststep.ai.
- Where are prices listed? https://www.1ststep.ai/pricing/ Starting ranges only. Every project is scoped on a free call, which is the Website Strategy Call at /book/.
